mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.team_code, t.team_name, t.department_code, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted_at FROM teams t WHERE t.team_code = #{teamCode} AND t.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

SELECT id, team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM teams WHERE team_code = #{teamCode} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag) VALUES (#{teamCode}, #{teamName}, #{departmentCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value})
mapper.update: UPDATE teams SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE team_code = #{teamCode}

UPDATE teams SET team_name = #{teamName}, department_code = #{departmentCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_at = NULL, delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} WHERE team_code = #{teamCode}
